Featured impact

Two problems I noticed — and worked my way out of.

Two recurring manual steps I simplified through AI-guided research, from a finance-operations background rather than a coding one.

Case Study 01

Weekly Statement Emails, Automated

The Problem

Some customers request a weekly Statement of Account, beyond what our automated dunning system covers — meaning a manual pull and send each week.

The Solution

Using AI to guide me, I put together an Outlook-based macro that generates and sends the weekly SOA to each relevant customer automatically — my first time building something like it.

The Outcome

Those statements now go out automatically every week, with no follow-up needed on my end.

Built with: Excel · Outlook · Google Gemini (research assistant)

See it in action (click to enlarge)

Case Study 02

Invoice Document Merging

The Problem

One account needs 3 extra documents (Bill of Lading, Purchase Order, Certificate ID) merged into every invoice, sourced from separate platforms — done fully by hand, in batches of up to 50 during peak periods.

The Solution

Working within our approved toolset, I used AI assistance to research and put together a simple Jupyter Notebook script that merges each invoice's document set into one compliant packet.

The Outcome

Cut prep time per invoice packet, even as batch volume scales into dozens at once.

Built with: Jupyter Notebook · Claude AI (research assistant)
